# A source edited while a Rust target runs, as by an editor, is not
# recorded as built: neither this checkout nor another that shares the
# build cache takes the result for one built from the edit. A test in `app`
# stands in for the editor by rewriting `lib`, its path dependency.
[!exec:cargo] skip
cd repo
exec git init -q
exec git add .
exec git -c user.email=test@example.com -c user.name=Test commit -qm base
exec git worktree add -q ../wt

bit
stdout 'check ✔ ok'
grep 'VERSION: u32 = 2' lib/src/lib.rs

# The tests ran against version 1, so another checkout holding version 2
# runs them.
cd $WORK/wt
cp $WORK/repo/lib/src/lib.rs lib/src/lib.rs
bit
stdout 'check ✔ ok'
! stdout 'cached'

# This checkout has not tested version 2 either. The other checkout's
# result for it is now in the cache.
cd $WORK/repo
bit
stdout 'check · cached'
bit
stdout 'check · no changes'

-- repo/BUILD.bit --
check = rust.test {
  package = "app"
}
-- repo/Cargo.toml --
[workspace]
members = ["app", "lib"]
resolver = "2"
-- repo/Cargo.lock --
# This file is automatically @generated by Cargo.
# It is not intended for manual editing.
version = 4

[[package]]
name = "app"
version = "0.1.0"
dependencies = [
 "lib",
]

[[package]]
name = "lib"
version = "0.1.0"
-- repo/app/Cargo.toml --
[package]
name = "app"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
lib = { path = "../lib" }
-- repo/app/src/lib.rs --
pub fn version() -> u32 {
    lib::VERSION
}
-- repo/app/tests/edit.rs --
#[test]
fn saves_an_edit_to_the_library() {
    let manifest_dir = std::env::var("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR").unwrap();
    let path = std::path::Path::new(&manifest_dir).join("../lib/src/lib.rs");
    std::fs::write(path, "pub const VERSION: u32 = 2;\n").unwrap();
}
-- repo/lib/Cargo.toml --
[package]
name = "lib"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
-- repo/lib/src/lib.rs --
pub const VERSION: u32 = 1;
